answer:
Yes. For FY2022, Boeing had total revenues of $66,608 million, and three of its primary segments each represented more than 20% of total revenue:
1. Commercial Airplanes segment revenues were $25,867 million (approximately 38.8%).
2. Defense, Space & Security segment revenues were $23,162 million (approximately 34.8%).
3. Global Services segment revenues were $17,611 million (approximately 26.4%).
rationale: Boeing's segment revenues for FY2022 were retrieved from the 10-K, and their percentages of total revenue ($66,608 million) were calculated. Commercial Airplanes (38.8%), Defense, Space & Security (34.8%), and Global Services (26.4%) each exceed the 20% threshold.
